in_sanskrit.name: आर्यध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is noble, virtuous, and honorable.

in_tamil.name: அர்யத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is among the noble people.

in_telugu.name: అర్యధ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Lord of the noble, or the noble-minded.

in_marathi.name: Aryadh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryadh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arya means noble or honorable in Sanskrit. Dh means 'that' or 'being'. The name Aryadh represents someone who embodies nobility and honor.

in_bengali.name: Aryadh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Noble, Honorable
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aryadh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Arya means noble or honorable in Sanskrit. Dh means 'that' or 'being'. The name Aryadh represents someone who embodies nobility and honor.
